events.title: Greenleaf Trust Sells 4,126 Shares of Amazon.com, Inc. $AMZN
events.summary: Greenleaf Trust has reduced its stake in Amazon.com, Inc. by selling 4,126 shares, bringing its total holdings to 461,920 shares valued at over $110 million. This comes amidst broader institutional investor activity in Amazon stock, with many adding to their positions. The article also touches on Amazon's recent earnings, insider trading activity, and a summary of recent news and analyst ratings on the company.

events.title: Amazon.com, Inc. $AMZN is Legacy CG LLC's 10th Largest Position
events.summary: Legacy CG LLC has reduced its stake in Amazon.com, Inc. by 9.8% during the second quarter, yet Amazon remains its 10th largest holding, representing 2.6% of its portfolio. Amazon reported strong quarterly results, exceeding analyst expectations with $200.61 billion in revenue and $5.75 EPS. Despite concerns about insider selling and an FTC lawsuit, analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating, with AWS and AI investments seen as significant growth catalysts.

events.title: SBI Securities Co. Ltd. Cuts Position in Amazon.com, Inc. $AMZN
events.summary: SBI Securities Co. Ltd. has reduced its holdings in Amazon.com, Inc. by 3.6% in the second quarter, selling 14,239 shares while still owning 377,671 shares valued at approximately $90 million. Despite this, Amazon reported strong quarterly results with revenue of $200.6 billion and adjusted earnings of $5.75 per share, leading analysts to maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $323.09. The company faces ongoing challenges such as regulatory scrutiny, particularly from an FTC lawsuit, and investor concerns regarding significant AI infrastructure spending.

events.title: Amazon.com, Inc. $AMZN Shares Sold by Securian Asset Management Inc.
events.summary: Securian Asset Management Inc. reduced its stake in Amazon.com, Inc. by 1.8% in the second quarter, selling 4,889 shares but still retaining a significant holding valued at $64.3 million. Despite this, Amazon remains a "Moderate Buy" among analysts with an average target price of $323.09. The company reported strong quarterly earnings of $5.75 per share, significantly beating estimates, and revenue of $200.61 billion, up 19.6% year over year.

events.title: Legal & General Group Plc Takes $8.41 Million Position in Serve Robotics Inc. $SERV
events.summary: Legal & General Group Plc has acquired a new position of 1.37 million shares in Serve Robotics Inc., valued at approximately $8.41 million, making it a 1.58% stake in the company. Other major institutional investors like BlackRock, Vanguard, and Geode Capital have also increased their holdings. Despite some recent analyst downgrades and a quarterly loss that missed estimates, the stock maintains an average "Moderate Buy" rating with a target price of $14.77, though executives have recently sold shares to cover tax obligations.

events.title: Gary Black Warns Tesla Risks Falling Behind in the Self-Driving Race: ‘Unsupervised Autonomy Is Becoming
events.summary: Investor Gary Black of The Future Fund LLC warns that Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) risks falling behind in the self-driving race as competitors heavily invest in unsupervised autonomous technology. Black points to Tesla's falling earnings estimates and the significant progress made by companies like Waymo, WeRide, Baidu's Apollo Go, and Amazon's Zoox in offering paid unsupervised autonomous rides. He argues that unsupervised autonomy is becoming "table stakes" in the global automotive business.

events.title: Market Analysis: Amazon.com And Competitors In Broadline Retail Industry
events.summary: This article provides a comprehensive analysis of Amazon.com (NASDAQ: AMZN) within the Broadline Retail industry, comparing it to its competitors using key financial metrics. The analysis highlights Amazon's potential undervaluation based on PE and PB ratios, strong profitability with high ROE, EBITDA, and gross profit, and robust revenue growth. The company also demonstrates a stronger financial position due to a lower debt-to-equity ratio compared to its peers.

events.title: Legacy Education Stock And 2 Education Shares Tied To Economic Connectedness
events.summary: This article examines three education and workforce development stocks—Legacy Education (LGCY), Lincoln Educational Services (LINC), and Phoenix Education Partners (PXED)—highlighting their connection to the concept of economic connectedness. It discusses how these companies provide vocational, healthcare, and career-focused training to enhance earning potential and social mobility, while also pointing out key risks and opportunities for investors. The piece suggests that as economic connectedness gains academic and data-driven traction, these companies may see increased investor attention.

events.title: Berkshire CEO Abel says Alphabet a 'significant player' in AI after growing stake in Q2
events.summary: Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel stated that Alphabet is a "significant player" in artificial intelligence, a perspective informed by the conglomerate's internal use of AI across its portfolio. Berkshire grew its stake in Alphabet significantly, adding $17 billion worth of shares in Q2, making it the third-largest holding in its equity portfolio. Abel also revealed that Berkshire initially took a $10 billion stake in Google 15 months ago at a 6.5% discount.

events.title: Jim Cramer: Hyperscalers 'Wrecked Their Balance Sheets', But Apple Carries Twice Alphabet's Debt
events.summary: Jim Cramer praised Apple's "pristine" balance sheet while criticizing hyperscalers for excessive AI data center spending, but financial filings reveal Apple carries significantly more debt than Alphabet. Despite Apple's higher debt load and negative retained earnings due to extensive stock buybacks, the market rewards it with a higher P/E ratio due to its substantial liquidity. The article questions whether Apple's balance sheet will remain pristine if it significantly increases AI infrastructure spending under its new leadership.

events.title: Billionaire Philippe Laffont Increased Micron 19-Fold and Added 49% to Amazon. Is This One Giant AI Demand Bet?
events.summary: Billionaire Philippe Laffont's Coatue Management significantly increased its positions in Micron Technology (MU) and Amazon.com (AMZN) in the second quarter. This move suggests a major bet on the AI demand cycle, with Micron providing high-bandwidth memory for AI systems and Amazon offering cloud services through AWS. The strategy aims to capitalize on both the component scarcity and the infrastructure ownership within the AI supply chain.

events.title: Should Tesla Be Kicked Out Of Magnificent 7?
events.summary: The article argues that Tesla should be removed from the "Magnificent 7" group of tech stocks because it is primarily an automaker, not a tech company, and its performance has lagged significantly behind its peers. While other Magnificent 7 companies are heavily investing in AI infrastructure, Tesla's core business remains car manufacturing, with its AI ventures like Full Self-Driving and Optimus robots still in early stages and facing skepticism. The author suggests the group should be called the "Mag6" to reflect the true tech focus of the remaining companies.

events.title: Equinix Unveils Equinix Fabric One, Redefining How Enterprises Connect Across AI, Cloud and Networking Infrastructure
events.summary: Equinix has announced Equinix Fabric One, a new managed connectivity service aimed at simplifying how enterprises connect their distributed cloud, network, and AI environments. This service, leveraging open connectivity specifications from AWS and Google Cloud, will automatically orchestrate and manage connectivity. Equinix Fabric One is designed to reduce the complexity of enterprise networking in the AI era and is expected to enter beta later this year, with general availability in 2027.

events.title: Uber lays off 3,300 employees as it restructures for faster growth
events.summary: Uber is laying off approximately 3,300 employees, about 10% of its global workforce, as part of a restructuring effort to reduce management layers and simplify operations. The company aims to reallocate resources to its core ride-hailing, delivery, and robotaxi businesses, while also tightening remote-work policies to concentrate teams in global hubs. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi stated that the savings from these changes will be reinvested in growth, innovation, and autonomous technology.

events.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest Says Amazon Has a Potential $1 Trillion AI Business Hiding in Plain Sight
events.summary: ARK Invest projects that Amazon Web Services (AWS) could become a "trillion-dollar-per-year" revenue business due to accelerating AI demand. The firm also highlights that Amazon’s AI-enhanced shopping features, particularly through Alexa, are leading U.S. consumers to spend 40% more per order. This bullish outlook is driven by surging infrastructure investments and the growth of "Agentic Commerce" in retail.

events.title: ChronoScale and Microsoft partner on 50MW deployment in North America
events.summary: Microsoft is collaborating with ChronoScale, Applied Digital's cloud spin-off, on a 50MW AI infrastructure deployment in the US. This deployment will utilize Nvidia GB300 NVL72 systems and liquid cooling, designed to support high-density accelerated computing. ChronoScale, which recently spun out from Applied Digital, aims to provide production-ready AI compute with high performance and scalability.

events.title: 11 Forgotten Books Every ’90s Kid Loved Growing Up
events.summary: This article looks back at 11 popular children's book series from the 1990s that, despite their initial success and presence at Scholastic book fairs, are now largely out of print or forgotten. It covers titles like Animorphs, Give Yourself Goosebumps, Sweet Valley Twins, and Dear America, highlighting their unique premises, publication history, and eventual decline in popularity. The author emphasizes how these books were once integral to the reading experience of '90s kids.

events.title: Adobe acquires Indian market intelligence startup Rilo
events.summary: Adobe has acquired Rilo, an India-based marketing intelligence startup, in a deal that includes licensing and the acquisition of its six-member team. Rilo's technology, which focuses on automating marketing workflows, is expected to enhance Adobe's existing products, particularly for larger customers. This marks Adobe's second acquisition from India, following Rephrase.ai in 2023, as the company continues to bolster its AI-powered marketing capabilities.

events.title: NetApp earnings today: AI momentum meets high expectations By Investing.com
events.summary: NetApp Inc. is reporting its first-quarter fiscal 2027 results today, with analysts expecting significant year-over-year growth in EPS and revenue, though sequentially lower than the previous quarter. Investors are keenly watching whether the company can convert its numerous AI design wins into sustained revenue and grow its Public Cloud segment. The company faces high expectations following a strong prior quarter, with options data suggesting another volatile stock reaction.

events.title: The Buzziest New Show on Netflix? A Video Game Trailer
events.summary: Netflix recently experienced a massive, worldwide viewership event that caused tech issues and topped its charts, not with a movie or TV show, but with an exclusive "extended look" trailer for the highly anticipated video game, Grand Theft Auto VI. This phenomenon highlights a growing trend among streaming platforms like Disney and Amazon Prime Video to diversify content beyond traditional film and television, incorporating elements like TikToks, mobile-first video, and video games to drive engagement and cater to evolving consumer preferences. The article suggests that as entertainment lines blur, streaming services are increasingly exploring ancillary opportunities to capture consumer attention.

events.title: Microsoft's AI Datacenter Expansion: A Game Changer for the Stock?
events.summary: Microsoft is expanding its AI datacenter footprint, with a new Saudi Arabia East datacenter region becoming available in November 2026, contributing to an estimated $44 billion in economic activity. This expansion is part of a broader strategy, reflected in its Q4 fiscal 2026 results which showed significant revenue growth in Azure and cloud services. While Microsoft's capital expenditures are substantial, analysts note the stock's valuation appears high compared to the industry.

events.title: Can Hedging and Long-Term PPAs Strengthen Vistra's Growth?
events.summary: Vistra Corp. is enhancing its earnings visibility and stability through a dual strategy of disciplined hedging and long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs). This approach, which includes significant contracts with Amazon Web Services and Meta, aims to reduce exposure to volatile wholesale power prices and convert more merchant generation into contracted revenues, ensuring more balanced earnings and supporting long-term investments. While Vistra's shares have declined recently, the stock trades at a discount compared to its industry, and its strategy is similar to other utilities like NRG Energy and NextEra Energy.

events.title: Is Microsoft Stock Winning The Move To The Cloud Or Just The AI Boom?
events.summary: Microsoft's growth engine has shifted from cloud migrations to AI consumption, with the company focusing on monetizing AI workloads and Azure AI platform adoption. While Azure's 43% growth is driven by AI, the overall Intelligent Cloud segment still grows at 32%. This change indicates Microsoft's successful pivot to a recurring, consumption-based AI model, and its future performance hinges significantly on continued AI adoption.

events.title: South Korea's semiconductor exports just tripled year-over-year. Is it too much of a good thing?
events.summary: South Korea's semiconductor exports surged 209% year-over-year in August to a record $46.65 billion, accounting for nearly half of the country's total goods exports. This boom is largely driven by AI infrastructure demand. While positive for the economy, economists are concerned about the potential impact if this rapid growth slows down abruptly, especially given challenges in other traditional sectors and ongoing monetary policy tightening.

events.title: DOJ expands beef antitrust inquiry to Amazon, Walmart, others
events.summary: The U.S. Justice Department has broadened its antitrust investigation into the meatpacking industry by requesting six years of beef pricing and procurement data from eight major retailers, including Amazon, Costco, and Walmart. This inquiry stems from record-high beef prices contributing significantly to food inflation, prompting President Donald Trump to publicly request a probe last year. The department is seeking detailed information on purchasing strategies, retail pricing, profit margins, and market analysis from these grocers to understand the drivers behind the escalating costs.

events.title: Microsoft to start disclosing Azure quarterly revenue as company consolidates business units
events.summary: Microsoft announced it will begin disclosing quarterly revenue for its Azure cloud business, providing more transparency about its competition with Amazon Web Services and Google. This change is part of a broader restructuring that consolidates the company's internal operating segments from three to two. CEO Satya Nadella stated that this new reporting structure will define Azure more purely as their consumption-based platform and infrastructure business, emphasizing the impact of AI on the company's products and business models.

events.title: SB Energy turning old 3M campus into a massive tech R&D, data center hub
events.summary: SB Energy, a SoftBank affiliate, has acquired West Austin's Highpoint 2222 campus, formerly owned by 3M, with plans to invest $1 billion into transforming it into a major tech R&D and data center hub. The 1.1-million-square-foot renovated campus will provide extensive space for thousands of employees and servers, establishing a significant presence for AI and finance operations in the region. This move follows the revelation of the acquisition price and details about the future use of what was previously a long-empty space.

events.title: How Equinix has found a niche in the multitrillion-dollar AI data center boom
events.summary: Equinix, a legacy data center company, has strategically positioned itself to benefit from the AI boom by partnering with Nvidia and Together AI, allowing customers flexible ways to run AI models. Despite being a colocation facility rather than a hyperscaler, Equinix's stock is up 33% this year, raising its market cap to $100 billion. The company's focus on inference and urban data center locations gives it a unique advantage in the evolving AI landscape, even as some investors remain skeptical about its growth potential.

events.title: Zoox vs. Waymo: Are Amazon and Alphabet Ready to Win the Robotaxi Race?
events.summary: Amazon's Zoox and Alphabet's Waymo are expanding their robotaxi services, intensifying the competition in autonomous ride-hailing. Waymo, already commercially advanced, is expanding to 14 U.S. cities and planning international growth, while Zoox is increasing testing locations to 12 U.S. cities and moving towards paid commercial service. The article evaluates the bull and bear cases for both companies, suggesting Waymo is currently better positioned due to its wider commercial footprint, though Zoox represents a higher-risk, potentially high-reward opportunity for Amazon.
